descriptionChirho: A worm or maggot, typically associated with decay and decomposition in biblical contexts (Job, Isaiah). All four clusters represent the identical meaning with only grammatical variation (bare noun, conjunction, preposition, plural). Multilingual glosses are unanimous: English 'worm/maggot', Spanish 'gusano/gusanos', Hindi 'kida/kide' (worm/worms), Arabic 'dud/dudah' (worm), Korean 'gudeogi' (maggot) in every cluster, Swahili 'minyoo/mdudu/mabuu' (worms/insects). No semantic distinction exists between any of the four over-split clusters.
